#!/bin/bash
# UniversePurpur Pterodactyl Installer
# Author: DevPapo | Maintainer: admin@scon.host

if [ -x "$(command -v apt-get)" ]; then
    apt-get update -y
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq file wget unzip
elif [ -x "$(command -v apk)" ]; then
    apk update
    apk add --no-cache curl jq file wget unzip bash
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "=========================================================="
echo " Instalando UniversePurpur (+15,000 Players Titan Engine) "
echo " Host: scon.host | Autor: DevPapo                         "
echo "=========================================================="

if [ -z "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    SERVER_JARFILE="universepurpur.jar"
fi

DOWNLOADED=false
# 1. Descarga desde URL directa si está configurada
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" != "null" ]; then
    echo "Descargando UniversePurpur desde URL directa: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    if curl -sSL -f -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
        if [ -s "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
            DOWNLOADED=true
            echo "JAR descargado exitosamente."
        fi
    fi
fi

# 2. Descarga desde Releases de GitHub si no se descargó aún
if [ "${DOWNLOADED}" = "false" ] && ( [ ! -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ] || [ ! -s "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ] ); then
    echo "Buscando release en GitHub: SrJayYT/UniversePurpur-..."
    LATEST_URL=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/SrJayYT/UniversePurpur-/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name | endswith(".jar")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)
    if [ -n "${LATEST_URL}" ] && [ "${LATEST_URL}" != "null" ]; then
        echo "Descargando build oficial desde GitHub: ${LATEST_URL}"
        curl -sSL -f -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${LATEST_URL}"
        if [ -s "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
            DOWNLOADED=true
        fi
    fi
fi

# 3. Fallback: Si no se descargó JAR binario automáticamente
if [ ! -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ] || [ ! -s "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    echo "Aviso: No se detectó un binario JAR remoto descargable."
    echo "Por favor sube tu JAR '${SERVER_JARFILE}' mediante SFTP a /mnt/server."
    touch "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
fi

# 4. Aceptar EULA automáticamente
if [ ! -f "eula.txt" ]; then
    echo "Configurando eula.txt (eula=true)..."
    echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
fi

echo "=========================================================="
echo " UniversePurpur instalado correctamente."
echo " Configuración de Puertos en Pterodactyl:"
echo "   1. Puerto Primario (Default): Minecraft Java (${SERVER_PORT:-25565})"
echo "   2. Puerto Adicional (Allocation): Web Panel & Portal (${WEB_PORT:-25566})"
echo "   3. Puerto Bedrock (Opcional): Geyser UDP (${GEYSER_PORT:-19132})"
echo "=========================================================="
